runs.text: 假设你是李津,你的美国朋友Wendy正在做一个课题:世界各地的生日庆祝方式。她请你介绍中国学生过生日的方式。请你根据下列要点写一封邮件,主要内容包括:
2.你认为更有意义的庆祝方式和理由。
(2)可以适当增加细节,以使行文连贯;
(3)开头和结尾已给出,不计入总词数。
2.主要人称为第三人称;主体时态为一般现在时。

Chinese students celebrate their birthdays in different ways, but the most common way is to hold a birthday party, at which friends get together to have fun drinking, singing and dancing.On the birthday, one usually receives nice gifts and good wishes from friends and parents.Sometimes, parents will prepare a special dinner or a cake to show their love for their children.

runs.text: 假设你是李津,最近你收到英国笔友Peter的来信,想就“How to live with pressure”的话题和你交流,询问你能否就解决学习和生活中一些问题谈谈自己的体验和感想。请根据此话题及以下提示写一封回信。
①过去遇到问题时的表现(如心理压力、情绪紧张、心情低落等)。
②介绍你解决压力问题的做法。
1.词数不少于100,开头和结尾已给出,不计入总词数;
3.可适当加入细节,以使内容充实、行文连贯。
Glad to hear from you. I’d like to write about how to live with pressure.
2.主要人称为第一人称;主体时态为一般过去时和一般现在时。
3.第一段介绍过去遇到问题时的表现(如心理压力、情绪紧张、心情低落等)及介绍你解决压力问题的做法;第二段提出希望。

Glad to hear from you. I’d like to write about how to live with pressure. Firstly, I’d take my problem as an example. I used to feel pressured to do well in exams. The pressure made me out of breath. To my disappointment, the more worried I was about my studies, the less efficient I became. So I realize I just take pressure too seriously. Secondly, let me tell you how to deal with it. I try taking things easy by taking part in various activities out of class, enjoying music and chatting with my friends about fun things. To my delight, this works.

runs.text: 假设你是晨光中学的李津。一个美国学生 Dennis 在Tik Tok上录制了他在纽约和多国留学生一起庆祝中国春节的视频。请你根据以下要点对视频留言评论。
1.表达自己看到视频后的心情;
2.赞扬他们的庆祝方式(如包饺子)和富有中国元素的室内布置(如中国结);
3.询问他们如何庆祝别的国家的节日。
2.庆祝方式和室内布置不仅限于所给提示;
3.请适当加入细节,使内容充实、行文连贯。
参考词汇:饺子 dumpling　中国结 Chinese knot
3.第一段表达看过视频后的心情;第二段赞扬他们的庆祝方式和富有中国元素的室内布置;第三段询问他们如何庆祝别的国家的节日。
Having seen the video that you and your foreign classmates celebrated the Spring Festival together, I felt very excited and was proud of our Chinese culture.

Making dumplings is the best way to celebrate the Spring Festival.Needless to say, you must have had a great time and have had a good knowledge of Chinese traditional diet custom.What’s more, it’s so considerate of you to show plenty of Chinese style in your room.For example, I have seen the Chinese knot, which is a symbol of Chinese culture.What you have done not only makes those Chinese students feel warm but also makes the Chinese culture spread widely.

runs.text: 青少年研究专家 Susan Taylor在自己的英文网站上开辟专栏,邀请大家分享心目中的“最好礼物”。她认为,礼物贵在心意,应为之付出时间和精力。
假设你是李津,请用英文发帖,内容要点包括:
2.可适当加入细节,使内容充实、行文连贯。
1.本文是应用文,形式为网络发帖。
2.主要人称为第一人称;主体时态为一般现在时。
3.第一段介绍写作背景;介绍自己并表达赞同的观点。第二段介绍自己收到或送出的最好礼物并描述该礼物的意义。
I am Li Jin, a high school student from China and I am quite for your opinion about best gifts: the value of gifts lies in its intention so we should devote more time and energy to them.

The best gift I’ve ever received is a book from my English teacher, Jenny, which she brought to me when she returned from her holiday in the USA.The book’s name is Chicken Soup for the Teenage Soul. I value this book very much because it not only shows me how to face challenges bravely but also some useful methods of getting along well with friends.And I can’t thank my favorite teacher too much for her care about me because she always encourages me when I feel depressed.Having read it, I have been truly inspired and kept the balance of friendship in a positive way.

runs.text: 假设你是晨光中学李津。为了响应“光盘行动”号召,反对舌尖上的浪费,本学期你校英语俱乐部开展了主题为“Clear Your Plate”的英语演讲比赛,请你以此为题准备一篇英文演讲稿参赛。内容包括:
1.同学们平时食堂就餐时浪费严重;
2.开头已给出, 但不计入总词数;
3.可以适当增加细节, 以使行文连贯。
Hello, everyone! Let me tell you something about “Clear Your Plate”.
1.本文是应用文,形式为演讲稿。
3.第一段介绍写作背景;介绍光盘行动的背景原因。第二段介绍同学们在学校食堂的浪费现状。第三段呼吁同学们节约粮食并提出建议。

Hello, everyone! Let me tell you something about “Clear Your Plate”. Recently, people have realized how much food we waste every year.And everyone is called on to join a campaign, called “Clear Your Plate”, which requires people to eat up all our food.

As for me,I think it’s an extremely good idea to follow.And there are lots of things we can do to contribute our efforts to it.For example,when we go out for dinner, we can just order as much food as we can eat to make sure little will be wasted.Of course if we really can’t eat up our food, it’s also OK to take it home, so we can eat it later.Besides, once we have a chance to have meals with other people, who don’t realize the importance, we can explain the purpose of the campaign and convince them not to waste food.

Good morning.Today I’d like to talk about the topic of carrying forward traditional Chinese culture.

3.第二段介绍弘扬中国传统文化的原因以及介绍你喜欢的中国传统文化并说明理由。第三段表达你的希望。
Good morning.Today I’d like to talk about the topic of carrying forward traditional Chinese culture.

As is known to us all, China has a long history and it is true that traditional Chinese culture has become more and more popular home and abroad. A great many arts and crafts draw attention of the world. It is of great importance to carry forward traditional Chinese culture.I am very fond of traditional Chinese operas, such as Beijing and Sichuan operas, through which I can learn the charm of the traditional Chinese drama.There is no doubt that we young people are increasingly interested in traditional Chinese culture.

2.主要人称为第一人称;主体时态为一般过去时(现在完成时)和一般现在时。
3.第一段为开场白及介绍高中三年自己的收获;第二段为即将毕业的心境及决心。

Good morning, dear friends. My name is Li Jin. It’s my great honor to share my feelings on graduation. It has been three years since I started my high school. At this moment, I cannot bear to part but I am also eager for my new life at university. During the three years, not only have I made some true friends who can share sorrows and joys with me, but also I have gained various knowledge.

Before leaving, I’d like to express my sincere gratitude to my teachers. It was they who patiently answered our endless questions. Besides, I owe many thanks to my dear classmates. Without their help and encouragement, I couldn’t have overcome so many difficulties. Now I’ve been determined to lead a more meaningful life at university and I will live up to the expectations of my teachers and my parents.
